clips.send: Pancreas beta cell. Someone just ate a cookie and blood sugar is rising! Ship 3 packages of insulin OUT into the blood. 1. Ribosome builds it: A ribosome on the rough ER builds the protein, following the DNA recipe from the nucleus. 2. Inside the ER: The new protein slides into the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and travels through its tubes. 3. Vesicle: ER, Golgi: A vesicle buds off the ER and carries the protein to the Golgi body. 4. Golgi packs and labels: The Golgi body finishes the protein, packs it and labels where it must go. 5. Vesicle, membrane: A new vesicle carries the package along tracks to the cell membrane. Moving it uses ATP. 6. Fuse and release: The vesicle fuses with the membrane and the contents spill outside. Exocytosis!
clips.text: Pancreas beta cell. Someone just ate a cookie and blood sugar is rising! Ship 3 packages of insulin OUT into the blood. 1. Ribosome builds it: A ribosome on the rough ER builds the protein, following the DNA recipe from the nucleus. 2. Inside the ER: The new protein slides into the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and travels through its tubes. 3. Vesicle: ER → Golgi: A vesicle buds off the ER and carries the protein to the Golgi body. 4. Golgi packs & labels: The Golgi body finishes the protein, packs it and labels where it must go. 5. Vesicle → membrane: A new vesicle carries the package along tracks to the cell membrane. Moving it uses ATP. 6. Fuse & release: The vesicle fuses with the membrane and the contents spill outside. Exocytosis!

clips.send: 胰岛 B 细胞（胰腺里）。有人刚吃了一块饼干，血糖在升高！把 3 包胰岛素运出细胞，送进血液。 1。核糖体制造: 粗面内质网上的核糖体按照细胞核里 DNA 的“配方”制造蛋白质。 2。在内质网里: 新做好的蛋白质进入内质网，在它的管道里运输。 3。囊泡：内质网，高尔基体: 一个囊泡从内质网“出芽”，把蛋白质运到高尔基体。 4。高尔基体包装、贴标签: 高尔基体把蛋白质加工好、包装好，并“贴上标签”标明送往哪里。 5。囊泡，细胞膜: 一个新囊泡沿着“轨道”把包裹运到细胞膜。运输要消耗 ATP。 6。融合、释放: 囊泡与细胞膜融合，里面的东西被释放到细胞外。这就是胞吐！
clips.text: 胰岛 B 细胞（胰腺里）. 有人刚吃了一块饼干，血糖在升高！把 3 包胰岛素运出细胞，送进血液。 1. 核糖体制造: 粗面内质网上的核糖体按照细胞核里 DNA 的“配方”制造蛋白质。 2. 在内质网里: 新做好的蛋白质进入内质网，在它的管道里运输。 3. 囊泡：内质网 → 高尔基体: 一个囊泡从内质网“出芽”，把蛋白质运到高尔基体。 4. 高尔基体包装、贴标签: 高尔基体把蛋白质加工好、包装好，并“贴上标签”标明送往哪里。 5. 囊泡 → 细胞膜: 一个新囊泡沿着“轨道”把包裹运到细胞膜。运输要消耗 ATP。 6. 融合、释放: 囊泡与细胞膜融合，里面的东西被释放到细胞外。这就是胞吐！
